title: Climate Resilient Rice Projects in Cambodia
reason: Describes the climate resilience project aimed at supporting rice farming in Cambodia.

tasks.task: Describe the climate resilience project for rice farming in Cambodia.

subtasks.text: Highlight the worsening impacts of climate change on Cambodia's agriculture-based economy.
Explain the specific effects of climate change in Prey Veng province.
Describe how the project helps farmers in rice production by rehabilitating and climate-proofing irrigation systems.
Mention the effort and satisfaction expressed by both farmers and project members.

tasks.task: Detail the additional benefits of the project.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of laser land levelling to conserve water and improve irrigation efficiency.
Explain the pilot testing of a weather-indexed crop insurance scheme.
Highlight the improvement in the availability and quality of rice seed through a certification system.
Mention the creation of more jobs for women through the project.
Conclude by mentioning the overall contribution of the project to the sustainability of rice farming in Cambodia.
